item.title: CV
item.description:
Employment

Current position (2026-present): Assistant Professor of Computational Neuroscience, Aarhus University, DK

Sep 2021 - Dec 2025: Postdoctoral Research Fellow, Aarhus University, DK

  • Large-scale project management: design, development, and execution of large human neuroimaging data collection and analysis
  • Technical expertise: application of Bayesian statistical methods, machine learning, and computational modelling of human neuroimaging (including time series analysis) and behavioural data
  • Effective communication and dissemination of results: through regular local, national, and international conference presentations (talks and posters) and written publications
  • Eleven presentations (talks and posters) across five different countries

Education

PhD: Wellcome Trust Fellowship, Neural Dynamics, University of Bristol, UK

Thesis title: “Modelling of Behaviour and Neuroimaging in Decision Making and Memory Through Application of Variational Bayesian Methods, In Health and Disease”. Link to Thesis

Supervisor: Prof Rosalyn Moran

  • Dynamic Causal Modelling: model fitting and estimation of EEG data (brain activity time series analysis) in Alzheimer’s Disease patients compared to healthy aged control participants
  • Active Inference: computational modelling of human decision making, model inversion, and parameter recovery and estimation
  • Decision making: Human fMRI brain imaging data collection and analysis, examining the effect of noradrenaline on prediction error
  • Six presentations (talks and posters) across four different countries

BSc: First Class (Hons) Biomedical Sciences (Neuroscience), The University of Edinburgh, UK

  • Final Year Dissertation: ‘Genome Editing with CRISPR/Cas9 to Explore the Function of Neural Stem Cell-Affiliated Transcription Factors’
